CalculatedInsight.description: Per-player per-opponent aggregates. Powers the reference query "Has anyone scored more goals against Chelsea than Salah?"
CalculatedInsight.label: Player vs Opponent
CalculatedInsight.sqlExpression: SELECT UnifiedPlayer__dlm.unified_player_id__c AS unified_player_id__c, UnifiedPlayer__dlm.player_name__c AS player_name__c, UnifiedTeam__dlm.canonical_team_id__c AS opponent_id__c, UnifiedTeam__dlm.team_name__c AS opponent_name__c, SUM(PlayerVsOpponent__dll.goals__c) AS goals__c, SUM(PlayerVsOpponent__dll.xg_total__c) AS xg_total__c, SUM(PlayerVsOpponent__dll.shots__c) AS shots__c, SUM(PlayerVsOpponent__dll.matches_played__c) AS matches_played__c FROM PlayerVsOpponent__dll JOIN UnifiedPlayer__dlm ON UnifiedPlayer__dlm.source_player_name__c = PlayerVsOpponent__dll.player__c JOIN UnifiedTeam__dlm ON UnifiedTeam__dlm.source_team_name__c = PlayerVsOpponent__dll.opponent__c GROUP BY unified_player_id__c, player_name__c, opponent_id__c, opponent_name__c
